# graylog_content_pack (Data Source)

Retrieves a Graylog content pack by ID and revision.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_content_pack" "example" {
  content_pack_id = "90be5e03-cb16-c802-6462-a244b4a342f3"
  revision        = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_pack_id` (String)
- `revision` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `name` (String)
- `payload_json` (String)
